name: WebEngine
dependsOn: WebGUI where DOM/UI primitives are required
owns: SiteTree projection consumption, validation, indexing, resolution and derived projections
WebEngine application/composition presentation semantics under the .we-* namespace
principles: the same canonical truth may have many projections
Navigation, breadcrumbs, sitemap and active navigation state are projections of SiteTree
Content, SiteTree, Navigation projections and Actions remain separate concerns
shell/page composition consumes authorities without replacing them
Actions binds user intent to external domain action references without owning business behavior
domain logic remains in the domain
derived paths are not duplicated in contracts
WebEngine owns presentation semantics while Style owns visual implementation
IAM identity context is adapted from IAM authority without copying session credentials into WebEngine
IAM management tiers remain user-management claims and are never translated into application permissions
logical site paths are independent of temporary deployment prefixes such as /test/
DWH is the canonical authority for website relation data used by SiteTree
WebEngine consumes the DWH #SITE symbol and does not know DWH storage or PHP implementation details
SiteTree navigation, breadcrumbs, sitemap and active state are projections of the validated #SITE runtime snapshot
mustNot: contain LMTS, IAM, Freemarket or other domain business logic
encode visual appearance into .we-* semantic class names
use .we-* as a namespace for domain business semantics
execute domain business behavior inside the Actions subsystem
store navigation or action semantics as Content
create an independent navigation hierarchy beside SiteTree
store IAM passwords or raw bearer/session tokens
interpret IAM management tier as application authorization
hardcode /test or another deployment prefix into canonical domain/site data
treat site.json or another serialized artifact as SiteTree authority
query DWH database tables or infer DWH relations from storage layout
duplicate DWH relation semantics inside WebEngine
